chunks: He turned away from them and said: "O my people, I have conveyed to you the message of my Lord and advised you well, but you do not love those who give sincere advice."

key_terms.نَصَحْتُ: I advised well / I was sincere

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about why people reject sincere advice?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *balagh* (clear delivery) and *nasihah* (sincere advice) as the Prophet's primary duties, absolving him of the people's rejection. It highlights the psychological barrier where truth is often rejected not due to lack of clarity, but because the recipients dislike the truth-tellers, a theme central to the prophetic experience across various nations.
